def transform(grid):
    # Objects above the solid color bar fall by one row per occupied column, cascading
    # to the bottom; infer placements from demo: retain colored shapes, packed downward.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Each nonzero cell above uniform full-width row is moved down by number of preceding
    # occupied cells in its column? Demo objects settle, preserving rows order.
    bar=next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0),h)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if bar<h: out[-1]=grid[bar][:]
    # gravity per each vertical column, while full-row bar forms floor; count colored cells
    # and place bottom aligned within area above floor, allowing horizontal components.
    # Demo's vertical columns show original positions shifted down varying: row1 -> row6 etc.
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r in range(bar) for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v]
    # Translation by common +6 in demo? top bar at bottom, objects translate down 6 rows; clip
    # instead observed objects stack on bottom rows, preserving relative coordinates.
    shift=max(0, h-1-max(r for r,c,v in cells))
    for r,c,v in cells:
        if r+shift<h-1: out[r+shift][c]=v
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Find full-width nonzero divider; objects settle toward it.
    bar=next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] and all(x==row[0] for x in row)), None)
    if bar is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    direction=-1 if bar==0 else 1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Components excluding the divider.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if out[r][c] and r!=bar and (r,c) not in seen:
          color=out[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
          while stack:
            y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for q in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
              yy,xx=q
              if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and yy!=bar and q not in seen and out[yy][xx]==color:
                seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
          comps.append(comp)
    # Process nearest-to-divider first, preserving order; slide each component until blocked.
    comps.sort(key=lambda p: min(y for y,x in p) if direction<0 else -max(y for y,x in p))
    for comp in comps:
      for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=0
      while True:
        nxt=[(y+direction,x) for y,x in comp]
        if any(y<0 or y>=h or y==bar or out[y][x] for y,x in nxt): break
        comp=nxt
      for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=grid[next((rr for rr,cc in []),0)][0] if False else 0
    # Above placement must retain original colors by component.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if out[r][c] and r!=bar and (r,c) not in seen:
          color=out[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
          while stack:
            y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
              if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and yy!=bar and (yy,xx) not in seen and out[yy][xx]==color:
                seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
          comps.append((color,comp))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]; out[bar]=grid[bar][:]
    comps.sort(key=lambda z:min(y for y,x in z[1]) if direction<0 else -max(y for y,x in z[1]))
    for color,comp in comps:
      while True:
        nxt=[(y+direction,x) for y,x in comp]
        if any(y<0 or y>=h or y==bar or out[y][x] for y,x in nxt): break
        comp=nxt
      for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=color
    return out
PY
